entities.summary: Congress, a political institution in Argentina during Independence, Civil Wars, and National Organization (1810–1820). Grew from May Revolution (Revolución de Mayo) — May 25, 1810. Led to the emergence of May Revolution and Independence and Declaration of independence at Tucumán — July 9, 1816.
